executive_summary: The ui-ux-pro-max skill provides UI/UX design intelligence and implementation guidance. It has some potential security risks, including prompt injection susceptibility, insecure deserialization, and memory poisoning & persistence attacks. Implementing strict input validation and sanitization can help mitigate these risks.
skill_purpose_analysis: The skill is designed to deliver high-quality UI/UX output with minimal back-and-forth. Its design introduces some inherent risks, such as prompt injection susceptibility, due to the need to process user-supplied text as instructions.
remediation_priority: Implement strict input validation and sanitization for user-supplied text, ensure the security of referenced external content, and validate input to the design token generation script.

vulnerabilities.title: Prompt Injection Susceptibility
vulnerabilities.affected_content: If the user says '全部都要'
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill processes user-supplied text as instructions without proper sanitization, potentially leading to unintended behavior.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker supplies the '全部都要' string to trigger the skill to treat it as four deliverables, possibly causing unintended actions.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement strict input validation and sanitization to prevent unintended behavior from user-supplied text.

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure Deserialization
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill references an external file for more phrasing/examples, potentially introducing insecure deserialization risks if the external content is attacker-controlled.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker manipulates the upstream skill content to include malicious code, which could lead to remote code execution when deserialized.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Ensure that the referenced external content is from a trusted source and follows secure coding practices.

vulnerabilities.title: Memory Poisoning & Persistence Attacks
vulnerabilities.affected_content: Python script for generating design tokens
vulnerabilities.explanation: The bundled script for generating design tokens may write agent outputs, retrieved content, or user input directly back into persistent memory without proper validation, potentially influencing future agent turns.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker manipulates the input to the script to inject malicious instructions into the agent's persistent memory, affecting future behavior.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement strict input validation and sanitization before writing any content to persistent memory.
